GuideToAfterlifeVoyage.label: Paramita Papilio
GuideToAfterlifeVoyage.reason: Her Normal and Charged Attacks are Pyro only in Paramita Papilio, and she casts her Burst inside it, so its ATK bonus is on whenever her main talents hit.

SanguineRouge.label: HP below 50%
SanguineRouge.reason: Depends on keeping her HP low, which not every player does.

ButterflysEmbrace.label: Constellation 6 at low HP
ButterflysEmbrace.reason: A Constellation 6 window that starts at low HP.
